title: Implement Hydroponics Advisor output adapter and clarify/task-request handoff

gates.name: advisor adapter tests
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/advisory backend/tests/agent_harness backend/tests/publication backend/tests/integration backend/tests/security

gates.name: harness evals
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/advisory backend/tests/agent_harness backend/tests/publication backend/tests/integration backend/tests/security -k 'advisor or clarify or task_request or eval'

verify: Advisor output distinguishes hypothesis, recommendation, clarification, safety_block, and task_request claim types.
Missing/stale/insufficient evidence produces clarify or measurement-task request handoff without direct task creation.
Consultant context may receive advisory/read output but cannot create domain task/recommendation/action records by default.
evidence_required: advisor output adapter and MessageEnvelope handoff test output
VERDICT: PASS, SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present
constraints: Raw provider output is not displayed or published until adapted through FT-009.
Task creation and follow-up outcome semantics are owned by FT-013.
Output is concise, scoped to current Plant, redacted, and backed by source/evidence refs.
invariants: The model proposes; the harness validates and records.
Every runtime decision and publication path is MessageEnvelope/Bus/UI isolated.
No fake advisor success on provider/model failure.
